inputs.reference_definition: Apply the frozen Stage-04 positive/ambiguous/negative semantic-support classifier without changing its thresholds.

data_boundary.commissioning_fit_purpose: Select the runtime admission rule and supply admitted observations to later correction, covariance and availability stages.
data_boundary.final_audit_rule: Do not open final-audit RGB or masks until Stages 06-08 are locked.
data_boundary.spatial_unit: 3.2 m capture block; all positions, headings and cameras in one block stay together.
data_boundary.fold_assignment: Sort commissioning block IDs and assign consecutive IDs round-robin to folds 0-4.
data_boundary.detector_split_warning: detector_fit and detector_validation images were used to train the Stage-05 detector. Boxes here are optimistic. Do not use these records to characterise detector performance.

runtime_features: detected box width and height in the original 1280x720 image
detected-to-predicted hull width and height ratios
detected bottom-edge shortfall from the predicted hull
mandatory_runtime_checks: A finite positive-area box exists at or above the candidate confidence.
The calibrated floor back-projection is finite.
The predicted visual-hull box and equivalent-position Jacobian are finite and invertible under the frozen condition-number limit.
evaluation_only_fields: semantic robot mask and its visible-support class

candidate_grid.maximum_detected_to_predicted_shape_rati: reciprocal of the selected minimum ratio

primary_reference.unusable: Frozen semantic-support class ambiguous or negative.
primary_reference.rationale: Recognition alone is insufficient. A usable localization return must contain a supported robot body and contact edge, not a sliver or a few pixels.

selection_rule: Discard candidates that fail any feasibility constraint.
Maximize the minimum recall over the five spatial folds.
Then minimize admitted non-positive views, catastrophic count and p95 corrected error in that order.
A remaining tie prefers the lower confidence threshold, smaller minimum side, lower minimum shape ratio and larger bottom-shortfall allowance.

prior_sensitivity.primary_selection_prior: exact commanded pose, used only offline to select the visibility gate
prior_sensitivity.runtime_prior: timestamp-matched robot belief; ground truth is forbidden
prior_sensitivity.post_selection_diagnostic: Four deterministic perturbations per opportunity. Each uses independently keyed Gaussian xy noise with sigma 0.10 m clipped to +/-0.20 m per axis and yaw noise with sigma 5 degrees clipped to +/-10 degrees.
prior_sensitivity.advance_requirement: Report the full sensitivity result. If perturbed-prior precision falls below 0.97 or catastrophic admitted error exceeds 0.02, stop before Stage 07 and revise the protocol.

reporting: Counts and precision/recall by camera and spatial fold.
Detector returns, admitted returns and reference-positive opportunities as distinct quantities.
False admissions on zero-mask and ambiguous views.
Raw and silhouette-corrected median, RMS, p90 and p95 ground error for admitted readings.
Performance by visible width and visible-support reason.
The frozen Camera-D sliver challenge must be refused if it is present; otherwise run it later as a named diagnostic.
prohibitions: No semantic mask, commanded pose or realized error may enter the deployed gate.
No threshold may be changed after final-audit access.
No admitted detection is called accurate until its ground-plane error is reported.
No detector miss is dropped from opportunity coverage.
Do not treat headings or camera frames at one place as independent replicates.

derived_from.changes: authorized_role and authorized_views only; gate, detector, thresholds and prohibitions are byte-identical

purpose: Run the frozen detector over the 120 detector-split static positions so that ALL 400 master-capture positions have commissioning-gate outputs. These positions trained the detector; any model fitted on them is contaminated by construction and must be reported as such.
